researchDraft.querySummary: 本次扫描覆盖宏观金融、产业贸易、健康科学、气候环境、人口社会、制度文化、技术AI等有证据支撑的领域；能源资源、城市基础设施、地缘安全因采集超时而缺乏可验证证据。依据可核实的两源配对，形成10个候选信号：脑肿瘤快速检测、NHS员工停职、ADHD/自闭症两年等待、OpenAI代理入侵澳政府网站、新泽西数据中心违规发电机罚款、柴油价格飙升与欧盟反制、美中首脑会晤无实质突破、El Niño与全球气候风险、英国法院积压导致性犯罪者释放、俄袭乌克兰数据中心。所有候选均保持至少两个独立发布源。

en.title: Rapid brain tumour test cuts diagnosis from eight weeks to two hours
en.coreFact: A new rapid test is transforming brain tumour diagnosis, reducing waiting time from about eight weeks to roughly two hours, according to BBC and Guardian reporting from UK hospitals.
en.whyItMatters: Diagnostic latency is a structural bottleneck in cancer care. A test that compresses weeks of uncertainty into a single clinical encounter can alter treatment pathways, patient outcomes and the economics of specialist referral systems.
en.processMatchReason: No existing world process directly covers diagnostic capacity; not forced.

zh.whyItMatters: 诊断延迟是癌症治疗中的结构性瓶颈。将数周的不确定性压缩为一次临床接触，可改变治疗路径、患者预后以及专科转诊体系的经济性。
zh.processMatchReason: 现有世界过程未直接涵盖诊断能力，不做强行匹配。

en.title: UK diesel near all-time high; EU warns Trump export ban would hurt both sides
en.coreFact: UK diesel prices are close to an all-time high, with hundreds of Scottish forecourts above £2 a litre, while the EU says Trump’s plan to ban US diesel exports would negatively impact both sides, per BBC and Guardian reporting.
en.whyItMatters: Diesel is a strategic industrial fuel. Simultaneous price stress and export-ban threats show how energy policy is becoming a direct instrument of trade and geopolitical leverage, with immediate cost pass-through to consumers and industry.
en.processMatchReason: Fits energy security as strategic capacity, particularly the intersection of fuel supply, trade policy and geopolitical leverage.

zh.title: 英国柴油价格接近历史高位；欧盟警告特朗普出口禁令将损害双方
zh.coreFact: 据BBC与《卫报》报道，英国柴油价格接近历史高位，苏格兰数百个加油站价格超过每升2英镑；欧盟表示特朗普禁止美国柴油出口的计划将负面影响双方。
zh.whyItMatters: 柴油是战略性工业燃料。价格压力与出口禁令威胁同时出现，表明能源政策正成为贸易与地缘博弈的直接工具，成本将迅速转嫁给消费者与工业。
zh.processMatchReason: 契合能源安全作为战略能力的主题，尤其是燃料供应、贸易政策与地缘杠杆的交汇点。

en.title: Supersized El Niño flagged as lethal combination with human folly
en.coreFact: The Guardian editorial warns that a supersized El Niño, combined with human folly, is a lethal combination; separately, Brazil farmers lost 240 million litres of milk after heat, and extreme heat is affecting workers as a federal rule is frozen.
en.whyItMatters: A strong El Niño amplifies food, energy and health risks across supply chains. The combination of extreme heat, policy paralysis and agricultural losses points to compounding climate vulnerability.
en.processMatchReason: No existing world process directly covers climate oscillation risk; not forced.

zh.title: 超强厄尔尼诺被指与人类愚行形成致命组合
zh.coreFact: 《卫报》社论警告，超强厄尔尼诺与人类愚行相结合将形成致命组合；另有报道称巴西农民因高温损失2.4亿升牛奶，且联邦高温规则冻结之际工人仍在极端高温下劳作。
zh.whyItMatters: 强厄尔尼诺会放大供应链中的粮食、能源与健康风险。极端高温、政策停滞与农业损失叠加，指向复合型气候脆弱性。
zh.processMatchReason: 现有世界过程未直接涵盖气候振荡风险，不做强行匹配。

en.title: NHS England to suspend staff suspected of snooping on patient records
en.coreFact: NHS England will immediately suspend staff suspected of improperly accessing patient records, with its boss saying suspected snooping should lead to immediate suspension, per BBC and Guardian reports.
en.whyItMatters: Patient-record privacy is a foundational trust condition for digital health systems. A shift toward immediate suspension signals tighter internal enforcement and could reshape how NHS bodies balance employee rights, security and public confidence.
en.processMatchReason: No existing world process covers health-data governance; not forced.

zh.title: 英格兰NHS将立即停职涉嫌窥探患者记录的员工
zh.coreFact: 据BBC与《卫报》报道，英格兰NHS将立即停职涉嫌不当访问患者记录的员工，其负责人称疑似窥探行为应导致立即停职。
zh.whyItMatters: 患者记录隐私是数字健康系统的基础信任条件。转向立即停职意味着内部执法趋严，可能重塑NHS机构在员工权利、安全与公众信心之间的平衡。
zh.processMatchReason: 现有世界过程未涵盖健康数据治理，不做强行匹配。
